newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Shares in Astra fall on Merck downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Astra fall on Merck downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Swedish drugs group Astra tumbled on Wednesday in the wake of its U.S. partner Merck which fell after being downgraded.
"Several U.S. firms have downgraded Merck and this weighs on the Astra share," a chief dealer said. .
At 1430 GMT, Astra's A share was nine crowns lower at 340.5.
Merck has been downgraded by Morgan Stanley, Merrill Lynch and Alex Brown.
Merck and Astra own 50 percent each in U.S. group Astra Merck Inc.
Analysts said the downgrades stemmed from a poll of medical doctors showing Warner-Lambert's newly launched anti-cholesterol drug Lipitor was more favourably received than expected.
Lipitor competes with Merck's drugs Mevacor and Zocor.
